meta.source: ACSS 4.0.1 stylesheet served by staging.crownmovers.ca, read 2026-09-29. Token names are the ACSS variable names.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Crown Coral #F04836 = ACSS --primary. Primary buttons (base text on it, 4.94:1), large numerals, focus ring, route marks. Never white text on coral (3.69:1). Small text in coral only on ink (4.94:1), never on white (3.69:1) or paper (3.39:1).

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: #FF6B56 = ACSS --primary-hover. Primary button hover; base text on it 6.51:1.

tokens.name: primary-ultra-light
tokens.usage: #FFE7E2 = ACSS --primary-ultra-light. Icon wells and rare highlight tints; base text 15:1.

tokens.name: base
tokens.usage: Warm ink #161513 = ACSS --base. Text, headings, ink sections, the ink button. 18.3:1 on white, 16.8:1 on paper.

tokens.name: base-dark
tokens.usage: #222222 = ACSS --base-dark (bg-dark). Ink button hover, secondary dark band.

tokens.name: base-light
tokens.usage: Warm border #D8D5CF = ACSS --base-light (bg-light, border-color-dark). Card borders and dividers. Decorative only (1.46:1 on white): never a form-field boundary.

tokens.name: base-ultra-light
tokens.usage: Paper #F7F5F1 = ACSS --base-ultra-light (bg-ultra-light). The warm alternate section surface; base text 16.8:1.

tokens.name: neutral
tokens.usage: Grey #777D83 = ACSS --neutral. Icons and form-field borders (4.16:1, passes 3:1). Not body text: 4.16:1 on white, 3.82:1 on paper.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Amber #F89C3E = ACSS --accent. Logo-gradient partner; marks and stars on ink (8.5:1). Never text or meaningful graphics on white (2.14:1). Never a button.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: = ACSS --white. Page ground and cards; text on ink 18.3:1.

tokens.name: text-dark
tokens.usage: = ACSS --text-dark. Default text on white and paper.

tokens.name: text-dark-muted
tokens.usage: = ACSS --text-dark-muted (80% ink). Card body and intros: 9.7:1 on white, 9.2:1 on paper.

tokens.name: text-light
tokens.usage: = ACSS --text-light. Text on ink and on photo overlays.

tokens.name: text-light-muted
tokens.usage: = ACSS --text-light-muted. Secondary text on ink and overlays.

tokens.name: bg-ultra-dark
tokens.usage: = ACSS --bg-ultra-dark (.bg--ultra-dark). Ink sections: quote panel, CTA, footer.

tokens.name: focus-color
tokens.usage: = ACSS --focus-color. 2px outline at 2px offset: 3.69:1 white, 3.39:1 paper, 4.94:1 ink (all pass 3:1).

styles.name: h1
styles.sample: Montreal movers who take it personally
styles.usage: = ACSS --h1, fluid 31.1–47.4px. One per page. Sample copy is a placeholder.

styles.name: h2
styles.sample: Everything the move needs, one crew

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Stats and process numbers: --h1 size at 800. Coral on light surfaces is allowed only at this size (large text, 3:1).

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Tell us where and when. A coordinator calls you back with a written price.
styles.usage: = ACSS --text-l, fluid 19.2–24px. Hero lead, section intros.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Apartments, condos and houses across Greater Montreal, wrapped, loaded and set up by one accountable crew.

styles.name: label-caps
styles.usage: = ACSS --text-xs, uppercase. Ink with a coral bar on light surfaces; coral text only on ink.

tokens.name: notch
tokens.usage: Crown-angle cut on the quote card corner and the hero's slanted edge (3x). One per section, never on buttons.

tokens.name: radius-circle
tokens.usage: = ACSS --radius-circle (50vw). Avatars, dots. No pill buttons.

tokens.name: box-shadow-2
tokens.usage: = ACSS --box-shadow-2. Floating panels on light surfaces.

fluidType.note: Exact ACSS clamp() values (16px root). These are the variables the site uses.

fluidSpace.note: Exact ACSS clamp() values. Use these names in Bricks classes; never raw px.
